en: The postcard features a colored photograph of a busy port scene with a large steamship docked, people working on the quay, and various cargo or luggage items scattered around. On the reverse, there is handwritten text, official markings, and a faint stamp mark. The left margin references 'Edition Velcheff 1913, Varna'. The front image has text in Bulgarian, French, and English indicating it's the port of Varna.
